title: Runnable agent + FastAPI + local-fake adapter
acceptance_criterion: Normal task completes; missing evidence produces a supported refusal; failed tool is visible
verdict: The API surface + auth + fixed answer/refuse graph + idempotent ledger are real and tested. But 2 of the 3 AC clauses are not honestly satisfied (failed-tool visibility unimplemented; refusal only vacuously tested), and the approval-gated ticket flow is not connected. NOT complete.
evidence: src/agentops_workbench/graph/fixed.py: retrieve (reads fixtures/docs directly) -> _classify (keyword heuristic) -> answer|refuse
src/agentops_workbench/api/server.py: POST /v1/runs, GET /v1/runs/{id}, POST /v1/runs/{id}/cancel, POST /v1/actions; HS256 JWT; startup guard + alg allowlist (PR #8)
gaps: AC part 'failed tool is visible' is NOT implemented: _execute_run runs only run_fixed_graph, which issues zero tool calls; run.tool_calls is never populated by a run. No test.

AC part 'missing evidence -> supported refusal': the refuse branch exists (_REFUSE_MESSAGE) but its test test_fixed_graph_refuses_when_classifier_returns_refuse is vacuous — it asserts nothing unless route happens to be 'refuse'.
The proposal's core flow (answer + ticket draft -> POST /v1/actions/{id}/approve -> publish_ticket) is not wired: create_action only mints a nonce; it never calls the ledger.
test_run_reaches_terminal_state accepts state==FAILED, so it does not actually prove a normal task produces an answer.
_classify never returns 'clarify'; the clarify branch in fixed.py is dead unless the answer model self-flags.

synthesized.note: The /dev-kit:build runner was never executed in this monorepo. The AgentOps Workbench was built in a standalone repo and imported via PR #8, so no per-step sub-agent subprocess output was ever captured. This file is an audit of the shipped tree under apps/agentops-workbench/ against the step's acceptance criterion, plus a re-run of the deterministic gates on 2026-09-11. status / acceptance_met are judgements against the code as merged, not a recorded process exit.
synthesized.audit: 2026-09-11 (revised — first pass over-reported every step as completed)

gate_rerun.cmd: cd apps/agentops-workbench && uv run pytest -q ; uv run ruff check .
gate_rerun.failing_test_cause: Settings() reads apps/agentops-workbench/.env (strong AGENTOPS_JWT_SECRET) without isolating the pydantic-settings env-file source; the insecure-default assertion is not met. Passes in clean CI. Test-isolation defect, not a production bug.
